title: Release notes pocket guide and live stakeholder review sessions
creator: Aisha Kapoor
summary: Create a concise release notes 'pocket guide' for PMs/SEs and run live review sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to finalize internal and customer-facing changelogs.
description: Problem: Cross-team release notes reviews are inconsistent, causing last-minute edits, missed redactions, and unclear customer messaging. Goal: Produce a small 'pocket guide' template and checklist plus 3 scheduled live review sessions to accelerate sign-offs and ensure parity between internal and customer changelogs. Deliverables: 1) Pocket guide (convention + tone + redaction checklist + localization notes). 2) Canonical internal changelog draft. 3) Canonical customer-facing changelog draft (tiered: public, partner, enterprise). 4) Audit trail of sign-offs and edits. Success metrics: average time from draft -> signed reduced to <=48 hours; zero post-launch critical redactions; stakeholder satisfaction >= 4/5 on review survey.
acceptance_criteria: Pocket guide published to Confluence and linked in PRD
Three 45-minute live review sessions completed with notes and action items
Internal and customer-facing changelog drafts approved by PM, Legal, Security, and Design
Localization owners have annotated strings and acceptance plan for 3 priority locales
Sign-off log recorded in Drive with timestamps and reviewer names

review_feedback: Tom Reyes (Legal): Add explicit redaction step and contact for escalations; require Legal sign-off for enterprise-tier disclosures.
Priya Kaur (Design): Use componentized callouts to separate 'Breaking changes' and 'Recommended migration steps' visually.
Elena Mora (Support): Request an internal TL;DR and suggested customer support FAQs for top 5 items.
Samir Patel (SRE): Confirmed wording for incident-related SLA changes and recommended we include fallback behavior notes.
Jae Park (Localization): Provided three locale priorities and recommended truncation rules for UI-limited channels.
notes: Decision: Use a 3-tier changelog output: public (high-level), partner (detailed with migration notes), enterprise (full technical details + redaction flags).
Trade-off: More granular enterprise notes increase review overhead; mitigated by pocket guide checklist and mandatory Legal/Security pointers.
Contingency: If Legal sign-off delays exceed 72 hours, publish public changelog with 'enterprise availability pending' flag and send targeted comms to affected customers.

postmortem_plan: Collect feedback via short survey to review participants and iterate on pocket guide. Track time-to-signoff metric and redaction incidents; schedule retrospective within two release cycles.
